value.answer: The TSX is closed today for Thanksgiving, so no trading today. It's back Tuesday at 9:30 a.m. ET. Friday it closed at 35,664.62, up about 1.5% after weak jobs data (68,300 jobs lost) made a Bank of Canada rate hike less likely.
